'''Civ Sila''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] individual. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], they visited the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] with their friends [[Zey Nep]] and [[Dixon Just]], and their associate [[Artuo Pratuhr]]. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] ran into the club during their visit, before being [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|apprehended]] by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].

==Biography==
Civ Sila was a [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="AoTC" /> friends with the fellow Humans [[Dixon Just]]<ref name="CSWE1">{{CSWECite|II|183|Just, Dixon}}</ref> and [[Zey Nep]],<ref name="zn">{{DB|character|zeynep|Nep, Zey}}</ref> and an associate of<ref name="CSWE2">{{CSWECite|III|42|Pratuhr, Artuo}}</ref> the [[Archaeologist/Legends|archaeologist]]<ref name="sn">{{DB|character|seibnod|Nod, Seib}}</ref> [[Artuo Pratuhr]].<ref name="CSWE2" /> Dixon and Nep were often found in Sila's company.<ref name="CSWE1" /><ref name="zn" /> In 22 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]],<ref name="NEC Note">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. The scene from ''[[Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter]]'' in which [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] is in the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]] takes place immediately before the film, therefore meaning it must be set in that [[Standard year/Legends|year]].</ref> Sila, Nep, and Pratuhr visited the Outlander Club, a [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] hall located in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]] of<ref name="CSWE3">{{CSWECite|II|431|Outlander Club}}</ref> the Core Worlds [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="CSWE3" /> During their visit, the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] and [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] made preparations to [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|assassinate]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] there.<ref name="Jango">''[[Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter]]''</ref>

[[File:CivAndDixon-AOTC.jpg|thumb|right|350px|Sila and Dixon Just watched as Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker left with Zam Wesell.]]
During a [[Local day/Legends|night]]<ref name="AoTC" /> shortly afterwards,<ref name="NEC Note" /> Sila, with their friends and Pratuhr, visited the nightclub once more. During the group's visit, Wesell ran into the Outlander after failing to assassinate Amidala.<ref name="AoTC" /> Sila approached Just near the entrance of the club and the two talked. Concurrent to their interaction, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] entered in their search for Wesell.<ref name="AoTC" />

Later, Sila talked to their three companions near one of the club's<ref name="AoTC" /> [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolifts]].<ref name="CL" /> As Skywalker surveyed the clubgoers,<ref name="AoTC" /> Sila, cup-in-[[Limb/Legends|hand]], debated with Just,<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|75|Who's Who in the Outlander Club: It's Ladies' Night}}</ref> having separated from Nep and Pratuhr. Moments later, Wesell's arm was [[Dismemberment/Legends|cut off]] by Kenobi with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] in a failed ambush, drawing the attention of Sila and their companions. With Wesell apprehended, Skywalker told the clubgoers to go back to their drinks and left with Kenobi.<ref name="AoTC" />

==Personality and traits==
Sila was friends with Zey Nep and Dixon Just and possessed light skin and dark [[Hair/Legends|hair]].<ref name="AoTC" />

==Equipment==
Sila wore dark [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] at the club.<ref name="AoTC" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Taking the role of Civ Sila, Trevor Tighe joins the Droid Unit on their night out on the town.|Daniel Wallace|<ref name="Insider" />}}
Civ Sila appeared in the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']]<ref name="AoTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> where the character was portrayed by [[Trevor Tighe]], a member of the film's Droid Unit crew,<ref name="Insider" /> during the Outlander Club scenes shot at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]] on [[July 17]], [[2000]].<ref name="Mythmaking">''[[Mythmaking: Behind the Scenes of Attack of the Clones]]''</ref> Before the film's release, the character was first pictured with the<ref name="File">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Data File]]''</ref> [[April 22]], 2002,<ref name="Amazon">{{Amazon|url=-/es/Star-Wars-Episode-II-Attack/dp/0751347809|text="Star Wars Episode II": Attack of the Clones (Funfax "Star Wars" File Books)}}</ref> publication ''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Data File]]'', written by [[Jeremy Case]].<ref name="File" /> On [[April 23]] of that year<ref name="Preview">{{SWArchive|url=eu/lit/young/news20020225.html|text=Book Preview: Episode II Children's Books}}</ref> the character first appeared in an illustration in ''[[Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter]]'', a young readers book written by [[Eric Arnold]] and illustrated by [[Valerie Reckert]].<ref name="Jango" /> The illustration was an image taken from the upcoming film,<ref name="Jango" /> which released on [[May 16]], 2002.<ref name="Year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref>

Sila was first named in the article "[[Who's Who in the Outlander Club: It's Ladies' Night]]" written by [[Daniel Wallace]], which was published in the [[Star Wars Insider 75|seventy-fifth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine<ref name="Insider" /> on [[April 6]], [[2004]].<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20040315.html|text=The New Face of Evil}}</ref>
